title: Cross-Product Guidance — The Data Gateway Charge on an Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# The Data Gateway Charge

Guidance on the part of an amended annual fee carried for the site data gateway on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions, where the same building also holds a plan under Building Automation Service Plans. The shared share is 50 percent.

## Rule

Where the building's automation service plan stands active or in its renewal window and the subscription draws its data from the automation system, no data gateway charge is carried, because the point licence sits on that plan. Where the building's automation service plan stands active or in its renewal window and the subscription draws its data from more than one source, the data gateway charge is the tier's gateway fee reduced by the shared share. In every other case the data gateway charge is the tier's gateway fee.

## What decides it

Two records are read: the standing of the plan the building holds under Building Automation Service Plans, and the source the subscription draws its data from, as the subscription record holds it — the utility bills, the site's own meters, the automation system, or more than one source.

| Plan standing at the building | Subscription's data source | Data gateway charge |
|---|---|---|
| active or pending renewal | the automation system | nothing |
| active or pending renewal | more than one source | the tier's gateway fee less 50 percent |
| active or pending renewal | the utility bills, or the site's own meters | the tier's gateway fee |
| no plan, or a plan in any other standing | any source | the tier's gateway fee |

## Illustration (hypothetical, tier gateway fee USD 540 a year)

An active plan at the building with the subscription fed from the automation system: nothing. The same plan with the subscription fed from more than one source: USD 270.00. The same plan with the subscription fed from its own site meters: USD 540.00. No plan at the building at all: USD 540.00, whatever the data source.
